convert_caffe2_model_to_detectron: convert a Caffe2 classification model weights file to Detectron simple state dict format
decompose_bn_layers: decompose batch normalization layers into two separate AffineChannel layers in Caffe2 model weights
remove_bn_layers: remove and fold batch normalization layers into scale and bias parameters in Caffe2 model weights
absorb_input_std_to_conv1: absorb input standard deviation values into the conv1 weight tensor for Detectron compatibility
save_pickle_object: save a Python object to disk as a pickle file with atomic write and temp file cleanup
